hypothesis: the frozen pairwise ranker contains complementary proposals for 13 of the current policy's 57 misses, and a target-blind disagreement gate can select a safe subset without replacing or undoing the current 0.9715 policy
unique_variable: add one pairwise proposal as an optional override of the current served slot-10 choice; KEEP preserves the current policy exactly

supplemental_action.current_served_choice: current ranker choice when its frozen OOF admission activates, otherwise the P11 slot-10 incumbent
supplemental_action.available_when: pairwise choice differs from the current served choice and also differs from the P11 incumbent
supplemental_action.activated_policy: replace that turn's current served slot-10 choice with the pairwise choice while retaining all other current-policy decisions
supplemental_action.keep_policy: bit-exact current chosen and activation arrays

training_labels.construction: apply each available supplemental action in isolation on top of the complete frozen current-policy trace
training_labels.rescue: current session miss becomes a hit
training_labels.regret: isolated action lowers session reciprocal rank or increases first-hit turn relative to current
training_labels.reciprocal_rank_loss: max(0, current reciprocal rank minus isolated-action reciprocal rank)
training_labels.mttc_loss: max(0, isolated-action first-hit turn minus current first-hit turn)

cross_fit.outer: hold out one product-family fold from both supplemental heads and admission selection
cross_fit.inner: cross-fit both heads across the fixed inner folds within outer-train sessions
cross_fit.threshold_selection: map the selected inner-safe quantile to outer-train utility and apply only to the held outer fold
cross_fit.inner_safety: aggregate and every inner fold must have zero current-hit-to-miss, nonnegative MRR delta, and nonpositive MTTC delta
cross_fit.current_policy_role: frozen OOF comparator and immutable default action surface; it is not refit or tuned

decision_rule: Promote only if every gate passes and the exact repeat matches; otherwise close this supplemental formulation without changing features, weights, multiplier, or thresholds
